'''Freeholders' Base''', also known as '''Fyre's Base''', was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]].<ref name="EGTPM" /> Access to the base was via a [[Aquaris launching platform|launching platform]] that breached the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] of the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]], allowing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to land. Personnel were then transported to the base on the ocean floor via a [[Turbolift/Legends|lift]].<ref name="TG">"[[Traitor's Gambit]]"</ref> The base was operated by the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Aquaris Freeholders]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band that allied themselves with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
